title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 26 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 26)

content.overview: Section 26 is omitted from the current Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The former provision concerning an expert appointed by the arbitral tribunal is therefore not current operative law and must not be presented as a live statutory power under section 26.
content.glance: Section 26 is omitted from the current Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The former provision concerning an expert appointed by the arbitral tribunal is therefore not current operative law and must not be presented as a live statutory power under section 26.
content.study:
Section 26 — Omitted

Section 26 is omitted from the current Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The former provision concerning an expert appointed by the arbitral tribunal is therefore not current operative law and must not be presented as a live statutory power under section 26.

The repository must retain the former subject only as historical context if required. Current arbitral expert procedure must be located in the operative provisions and procedural orders applicable to the arbitration, not attributed to an extant section 26.
